key.name: panel-style
key.summary: Top bar shape
key.description: “None” leaves the shell theme untouched, “attached” styles the bar in place, and “floating” detaches it from the screen edges.

key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Top bar height in pixels

key.name: panel-margin-top
key.summary: Space above the top bar

key.name: panel-margin-bottom
key.summary: Space below the top bar

key.name: panel-margin-sides
key.summary: Space at the sides of the top bar
key.description: The default is three times the top margin, which is the proportion the floating bar was designed around.

key.name: panel-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the top bar

key.name: panel-border-width
key.summary: Border thickness of the top bar

key.name: panel-border-alpha
key.summary: Border opacity

key.name: panel-background-alpha
key.summary: Background opacity of the top bar

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent colour
key.description: Used for highlights and the active indicator. Hexadecimal, “#RRGGBB”.

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Top bar background colour
key.description: Empty means the colour comes from the wallpaper palette when that is enabled, and from the shell theme otherwise.

key.name: foreground-color
key.summary: Top bar text colour
key.description: Empty means it is chosen automatically for contrast against the background.

key.name: palette-from-wallpaper
key.summary: Derive the palette from the wallpaper
key.description: Extracts the dominant colours of the desktop background and uses them for the bar.

key.name: palette
key.summary: Cached wallpaper palette
key.description: Colours extracted from the current wallpaper, most frequent first. Regenerated automatically; not meant to be edited.

key.name: palette-slot
key.summary: Which palette colour the bar uses

key.name: fitts-widgets
key.summary: Make panel buttons reach the screen edge
key.description: Removes the dead zone above panel buttons so they can be clicked by slamming the pointer into the edge.

key.name: style-menus
key.summary: Apply the theme colours to popup menus
key.description: Panel menus, the logo menu, the applications menu and the cards use the bar background and accent colour.

key.name: style-osd
key.summary: Apply the theme colours to on-screen displays
key.description: The volume and brightness pop-ups use the bar background, and the level bar uses the accent colour.

key.name: style-dock
key.summary: Apply the theme colours to the dock
key.description: The dock background takes the bar colour (its opacity is still set in the dock settings), and the running indicators take the accent.

key.name: menu-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of popup menus and on-screen displays

key.name: menu-background-alpha
key.summary: Background opacity of popup menus and on-screen displays
key.description: Kept above 0.3 so menu text stays readable over any window.

key.name: dock-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the dock background

key.name: tiling-border-color
key.summary: Colour of the focused window border in tiling mode
key.description: Hexadecimal, “#RRGGBB”. Empty follows the accent colour.

key.name: tiling-border-width
key.summary: Thickness of the focused window border

key.name: tiling-border-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the focused window border

key.name: shell-theme
key.summary: Shell theme name
key.description: Theme from ~/.themes or /usr/share/themes. Empty uses the default GNOME Shell theme.
